masterPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: final illustrated character identity master for the existing Japanese gritty post-apocalyptic game, Paisen.
Input roles: images 1, 2, 3 are the SAME adult man's absolute identity, body and clothing references supplied by the game's producer. Image 1 is the primary exact FACE reference. Images 2 and 3 define physique and clothing. Image 4 provides ONLY the established hand-painted game rendering style, not identity or facial structure: REPLACE that angular slim face with the actual face in image 1.
Create one exceptionally faithful, finely detailed, full-body standing illustration of the exact man in references 1–3. Use a natural upright relaxed ready stance, facing slightly toward image right, arms relaxed and hands visible, two separate anatomically correct legs, both feet entirely visible. Face almost frontal in a slight three-quarter turn, both eyes readable.
Identity priorities: preserve the reference's broad rounded-square face and cheek volume, short straight black hair and natural uneven low hairline, thick dark eyebrows, exact eyelid shape and eye spacing, broad nose and nose-tip shape, medium closed lips, small natural chin/lower-face stubble, visible ears, tan skin and thick neck. Match the real reference proportions closely: do not beautify, narrow the jaw, make an anime hero, exaggerate muscles, or substitute a generic Asian face. Moderately stocky strong adult build with broad shoulders and normal arms, as in photos 2–3.
Clothing exactly: plain dark navy/purple short-sleeve crewneck T-shirt with natural soft folds, loose plain white knee-length shorts, no logos or armor. Simple worn dark charcoal low-top sneakers like the existing game character, no invented weapons or accessories.
Style only from image 4: finely worked gritty hand-painted realistic game illustration with restrained ink texture, muted earthy shadows, warm rim lighting and cool fill. Keep actual human facial contours instead of copying image 4's different face. Clean readable silhouette with detailed eyes, fabric and skin. One character only, vertical full-length composition with comfortable transparent margins around head, hands and shoes. Genuinely transparent background, no backdrop, floor, shadow plate, reference panels, captions, watermark, labels or extra objects.
